text.text: Why do you collect the data?
RemoteReason is a software company with headquarters in The Netherlands, EU and engineering offices in Romania.

RemoteReason is committed to protecting the privacy and security of your Personal Data. The information you share with RemoteReason enables us to code great, relevant experiences on our website and across all our other communication channels.
In addition, the Personal Data we collect helps us adapt our services and employment opportunities to your demands and needs.
